comments.author: auditor.readonly
comments.body: Recommend enforcing MFA reset for all Zenith Logistics accounts with portal access. Also suggest reviewing temporary worker access logs for Q2 2024.

comments.author: warehouse.lead
comments.body: Temporary worker has been removed from the schedule and their access revoked. Additional training on credential sharing planned for next week.

description: Marcus Rivera disabled 2FA on his account to share login credentials with a temporary worker during the night shift on 2024-05-14. The temporary worker used the account to update inventory counts, and the 2FA setting was re-enabled after the shift ended.
summary: 2FA bypass reported for warehouse supervisor account
